_comment: Counter-Strike 1.6 GoldSrc HLDS on ARM64 using Box64/Box32. Pterodactyl owns installation and startup.
name: Counter-Strike 1.6 (ARM64 / Box64)
author: ekretos
description: Pterodactyl-native CS 1.6 egg. Installer downloads SteamCMD game files and the repository startup script into /mnt/server; Pterodactyl executes start.sh at runtime.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

STEAMCMD_DIR="/home/steam/steamcmd"
STEAMCMD="$STEAMCMD_DIR/steamcmd.sh"

if [ ! -x "$STEAMCMD" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: SteamCMD is missing from the ARM64 runtime image."
  exit 1
fi

# Ensure Valve's ARM64 launcher resolves its 32-bit SteamCMD payload via Box32.
if [ ! -x "$STEAMCMD_DIR/linux32/steamcmd" ]; then
  "$STEAMCMD" +quit || true
fi
if [ ! -x "$STEAMCMD_DIR/linux32/steamcmd" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: SteamCMD linux32 binary was not bootstrapped."
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$STEAMCMD_DIR/linuxarm64"
ln -sfn ../linux32/steamcmd "$STEAMCMD_DIR/linuxarm64/steamcmd"

echo "Installing HLDS into /mnt/server..."
"$STEAMCMD" \
  +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 \
  +@NoPromptForPassword 1 \
  +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
  +login anonymous \
  +app_update 90 validate \
  +quit

if [ ! -x /mnt/server/hlds_linux ] || [ ! -d /mnt/server/cstrike ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Installation incomplete: hlds_linux or cstrike is missing."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading the Pterodactyl startup script..."
curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekretos/ogcounter/dev/docker/cs16-start \
  -o /mnt/server/start.sh
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/start.sh
echo "Installation completed. Pterodactyl will run ./start.sh on startup."

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: UDP game port exposed by the server.
